data.define: Said to show something is perfect, like a great meal.

misuse.text: Don't say 'chef's kiss' about burnt toast.

data.l1_hook: Goûte ça et dis‑moi, c’est un "chef's kiss" !

native.tip: “chef's kiss” = coup de maître. Exemple: “The soup was chef's kiss.”
